synthesis.description: Capability boundary, one-change probe, monitor/arm checks, meters, edge notes, safe levels, fault isolation; not executed.
Suggested diagnostics follow from device prerequisites; no experimental validation or personal artistic defaults.

uncertainties_and_gaps.issue: No full edition matrix or device minimum minor-version history; only REX explicitly requires Standard or Suite.
uncertainties_and_gaps.treatment: Require installed-version/license/device checks; retain explicit REX requirement only.

uncertainties_and_gaps.issue: Serial prose says both resonators output to Resonator 1, likely editorial error; signal-flow figures not rendered.
